label: v4 claim client
summary: Read and prepare explicit owner-authorized ERC-6909 claim actions without treating a displayed balance as transferable ERC-20 custody.
requiredFacts: Exact claim owner, operator, currency id, amount and PoolManager action
Which read block and chain produced the displayed claim balance
How mint and burn authorization differs from ERC-20 approval
How pending, replaced, reverted and reorged claim actions reconcile
requiredTests: Owner, operator, currency-id and amount mismatch rejection
Pending, reverted, replaced and reorged transaction handling
Confirmed PoolManager claim reconciliation at one block
risks: An ERC-6909 claim can be displayed or authorized as though it were an ERC-20 balance
A stale owner, operator or block snapshot can prepare the wrong action
A claim burn can exceed the confirmed owner balance
